Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to extract the correct genealogical information from the search results. In Step 1, the search query "Kuj Yoritsugu father" returned multiple sources (Wikipedia, historyofjapan.co.uk, military-history.fandom.com) that explicitly stated: "His father was the 4th Kamakura shogun, Kuj Yoritsune." However, the WebSurfer agent did not report this finding in its output. Instead, it only provided a generic description of the search page interface and metadata, completely omitting the crucial fact that Yoritsune is the father. This failure to extract and report the first link in the lineage chain (Yoritsugu -> Yoritsune) caused the subsequent steps to be based on an incomplete understanding, forcing the Planner to re-instruct the agent to search for the father again in later steps. This matches the error pattern of "Imprecise extraction of relevant details" and "Repetition of Source Checks" seen in the reference examples.
